hero.subheadline: Free digital art biennial on the future of the planet
hero.valueProposition: Professional artists and art students can win up to 3,000 PLN and have qualifying works exhibited in Poland and published in a bilingual catalog.

content.whyJoin:
The 3rd International Digital Art Biennial THE ONE, organized by the Pinata Foundation in Poland, is dedicated to the future of planet Earth. The title refers to Earth as the only known place in the cosmos where life has developed, and the contest aims to spark discussion about the environmental impact of human activity.

The contest awards 3,000 PLN for first prize, 2,000 PLN for second, and 1,000 PLN for third, plus honorable mentions. Qualifying works are shown in a post-competition exhibition scheduled for November-December 2026 at the Forum Gallery of the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń, with a further exhibition planned for May-June 2027 at the Suszarnia Gallery in Włocławek.

All works selected for the exhibition are included in a bilingual catalog in Polish and English with an ISBN, published in December 2026. Participation is free of charge, including for those who qualify for the exhibition, and printing of graphic artworks is covered by the organizer.
content.whoShouldApply:
This contest is for professional artists and students or graduates of art colleges and universities from around the world who create digital art. It suits artists working in digital graphics, digital painting, digital collage, or digital drawing, as well as video artists and animators producing videos or animations up to three minutes.

Because the theme addresses the future of the planet, it is well suited to artists who want to explore environmental themes, and participants must create their work without the use of artificial intelligence.
benefits: 3,000 PLN for first prize, 2,000 PLN for second, and 1,000 PLN for third
Exhibition of qualifying works in the post-competition exhibition at the Forum Gallery in Toruń
A further exhibition of competition works in May-June 2027 in Włocławek
Inclusion in a bilingual Polish-English catalog with an ISBN, published in December 2026
Free participation, including free printing of graphic artworks by the organizer
tips: Submit between 1 and 3 digital works by email to pinata.contest@gmail.com, the address for applications
Choose your category carefully: Graphics for digital graphics, digital painting, digital collage, or digital drawing, and Video for videos and animations
Keep videos or animations to three minutes or less to fit the Video category rules
Do not use artificial intelligence to create your work, since AI-created works are not allowed
Align your work with the theme of the future of the planet and care for the Earth, which is the focus of the biennial

faq.question: Who can participate in the biennial?
faq.answer: The competition accepts works by professional artists and art students from around the world, created using digital techniques. Participants may be students and graduates of art colleges and universities.

faq.question: What categories and formats are accepted?
faq.answer: There are two categories: Graphics, covering digital graphics, digital painting, digital collage, and digital drawing, and Video, covering videos and animations. Works must not be created using artificial intelligence.

faq.question: How many works can a participant submit and how?
faq.answer: Each participant may send between 1 and 3 digital works by email. The email address for submitting applications is pinata.contest@gmail.com.

faq.question: Is there a cost to participate?
faq.answer: No. Participation in the competition is free of charge, and participants also incur no costs after qualifying for the post-competition exhibition. Printing of graphic artworks is at the organizer's expense.

faq.question: Where and when are the exhibitions held?
faq.answer: The post-competition exhibition is scheduled for November-December 2026 at the Forum Gallery at the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń. Another exhibition is planned for May-June 2027 at the Suszarnia Gallery at the Browar B Cultural Center in Włocławek.

submissionGuide.detail: Create between 1 and 3 digital works in the Graphics or Video category. Graphics covers digital graphics, digital painting, digital collage, and digital drawing; Video covers videos and animations no longer than three minutes. Do not use artificial intelligence to create the work.
Download the registration form and regulations from the official website. Registration forms are available as PDF or DOC files in English and Polish.
Submit your application and works by email to pinata.contest@gmail.com before the September 15, 2026 deadline.

Qualifying works are selected for the post-competition exhibition in Toruń in November-December 2026. Prize winners are announced among the exhibited works, and the exhibition catalog is published in December 2026.
